_meta.source: curated emotion and feelings vocabulary seed
_meta.note: Comprehensive seed for the Cảm xúc & Cảm giác topic. Covers basic emotions, positive and negative feelings, anxiety, empathy, stress, calm states, social feelings, and common emotional phrases.

Her face was full of joy when she saw her family.

fieldValues.meaning: niềm vui sướng, sự thích thú
